name: Billing Statement 5
definition: Details of the statement reporting the bank services billing.

StatementIdentification.name: Statement Identification
StatementIdentification.definition: Identification of the customer billing statement.

FromToDate.name: From To Date
FromToDate.definition: Date range between the start date and the end date for which the statement is issued.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Date the statement message was created.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Defines the status of the statement.

AccountCharacteristics.name: Account Characteristics
AccountCharacteristics.definition: Specifies the details of the account characteristics.

RateData.name: Rate Data
RateData.definition: Identifies the non tax per annum rate and factor values used within the statement along with any time dependent charge basis.

CurrencyExchange.name: Currency Exchange
CurrencyExchange.definition: Specifies details related to currency exchange data.

Balance.name: Balance
Balance.definition: Identifies the average value of balances held within the statement period.

Compensation.name: Compensation
Compensation.definition: Identifies the set of values and totals that are used to provide compensation information, service and tax totals.

Service.name: Service
Service.definition: Specifies the values used for every line item service in the statement.

TaxRegion.name: Tax Region
TaxRegion.definition: Tax region that levy a tax on the services within this statement.

BalanceAdjustment.name: Balance Adjustment
BalanceAdjustment.definition: One or more sections that identify balance or float adjustments to the account. They can reflect either adjustments to the current statement or adjustments to statements from prior reporting periods.

ServiceAdjustment.name: Service Adjustment
ServiceAdjustment.definition: One or more sections that identify line item service adjustments to the account. They reflect adjustments to statements from prior reporting periods.
